meaning.en: Nearness, approaching; near. The root denotes physical or temporal proximity, especially drawing close to Allah.

lexical_analysis.al_raghib: الدُّنُوُّ: الْقُرْبُ مَكَانِيًّا أَوْ مَعْنَوِيًّا. وَهُوَ أَقْلُّ مِنَ الْقُرْبِ الَّذِي يَسْتَعْمَلُ فِي الْقُرْبِ الْإِلٰهِيِّ

quran_examples.context: The divine command to draw near through prostration

hadith.ar: إِذَا أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا نَادَى جِبْرِيلَ إِنِّي أُحِبُّ فُلَانًا فَأَحِبَّهُ
hadith.en: When Allah loves a servant, He calls Gabriel: Indeed I love so-and-so, so love him

shades.name_en: al-Dunūw — The Approach to Allah Through Worship
shades.name_ar: الدُّنُوُّ مِنَ اللَّهِ — الِاقْتِرَابُ بِالْعِبَادَةِ وَالطَّاعَاتِ
shades.explanation: The dunuw (approach, nearness) is closely linked to qurb. The verse 96:19 establishes that sujud (prostration) is the physical state of maximum nearness - the body in the lowest position while the soul is closest to its Lord. Al-Ghazali notes that the sujud is a paradox: the body abases itself before Allah while the soul ascends to divine proximity.
shades.hadith_ar: إِذَا أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا نَادَى جِبْرِيلَ إِنِّي أُحِبُّ فُلَانًا فَأَحِبَّهُ
shades.hadith_en: When Allah loves a servant, He calls Gabriel: Indeed I love so-and-so, so love him

meaning.en: Obedience, willingness, voluntary submission. The root denotes acting with consent and submission - as opposed to compulsion.

quran_examples.ar: فَلَا وَرَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّىٰ يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ
quran_examples.en: By your Lord, they will not believe until they make you judge in what has arisen between them
quran_examples.context: The full submission that is the mark of iman

hadith.ar: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَجِدَ حَلَاوَةَ الْإِيمَانِ فَلْيَحْبَبْ الْمَرْءَ لَا يُحِبُّهُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ
hadith.en: I heard the Messenger say: Whoever wants to taste the sweetness of iman should love the man whom he loves only for the sake of Allah

shades.name_en: at-Tawʿ — Obedience as Willing Surrender to Divine Command
shades.explanation: The tawʿ (obedience) in the Quran denotes active submission to divine command - not mere external compliance but a state of heart and will. The verse 4:65 establishes the quality of true iman: yuslimuna taslima - they submit in complete, unqualified submission.
shades.hadith_ar: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ: مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَجِدَ حَلَاوَةَ الْإِيمَانِ فَلْيَحْبَبْ الْمَرْءَ لَا يُحِبُّهُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Whoever wants to taste the sweetness of iman should love the man whom he loves only for the sake of Allah

meaning.en: Warning, alerting. The root denotes the act of alerting to danger.

quran_examples.ar: وَتَقُولُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
quran_examples.en: And say: We hear and we obey - those are the successful
quran_examples.context: The combination of hearing and obeying

hadith.ar: لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ
hadith.en: There has come to you a Messenger from among yourselves - heavy upon him is your hardship

shades.name_en: an-Nadhīr — The Prophet as Warner to the Worlds
shades.name_ar: النَّذِيرُ — الْمُنْذِرُ بِالْعَذَابِ إِنْ لَمْ يُؤْمَنْ
shades.explanation: The nadhir (warner) is a foundational prophetic title. The Quran describes every prophet as a nadhir - sent to warn their respective ummahs of divine punishment. The verse 4:65 emphasizes the link between hearing and obeying - the one who truly believes both hears the warning and accepts it with submission.
shades.hadith_ar: لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ
shades.hadith_en: There has come to you a Messenger from among yourselves - heavy upon him is your hardship

meaning.en: Gathering, collecting. The root denotes bringing things together.

quran_examples.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
quran_examples.en: Indeed Allah does not waste the reward of those who do good

hadith.ar: لَا تَقُصُّ رُؤْيَاكَ عَلَى أَخِيكَ فَيُؤْذِيَهُ
hadith.en: Do not narrate your dream to your brother lest it harm him

shades.name_en: al-Jamʿ — Gathering of Hearts and of All Things to Allah
shades.explanation: The jamʿ (gathering) operates in multiple dimensions: Friday gathering, Day of Resurrection gathering, jamʿ al-khayr (gathering of good things), jamʿ al-qulūb (unity of hearts). The jamʿ as a divine attribute: wa-huwa l-jāmiʿu bayna l-qulūb - only Allah can unite what humans have divided.
shades.hadith_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِ الْأُمَّةَ سَتَمْرَجُ مَرَجَ اللَّهِ
shades.hadith_en: Indeed this ummah will be gathered in Allah's gathering

meaning.en: To look, see, consider, wait. The root denotes visual examination and the act of waiting/deferring judgment.
meaning.ar: إِقَاءُ الْبَصَرِ عَلَى الشَّيْءِ، وَالتَّرَيُّثُ فِي الْأَمْرِ

quran_examples.ar: أَوْ كَٱلَّذِى مَرَّ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍۢ وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا
quran_examples.en: Or like the one who passed by a town - and it had fallen down upon its roofs
quran_examples.context: The parable of the man who passed by the ruined town

hadith.ar: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ
hadith.en: Part of the beauty of a persons Islam is leaving that which does not concern him

shades.name_en: an-Naẓar — Looking, Reflection, and the Deferral of Punishment
shades.explanation: The naẓar (looking, seeing, considering) is both physical and intellectual. The verse 2:259 uses naẓar in the sense of careful intellectual consideration. The Quran most frequently invites intellectual naẓar - to look, to reflect, to consider the signs.
shades.hadith_ar: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ
shades.hadith_en: Part of the beauty of a persons Islam is leaving that which does not concern him

quran_examples.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا
quran_examples.en: Do not the disbelievers know that the heavens and the earth were a single unit, then We split them apart?
quran_examples.context: The piercing of the heavens and the earth apart from one another

hadith.en: The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful

shades.name_en: an-Nafj — Cosmic Piercing as Origin of Distinction and Existence
shades.name_ar: النَّفْجُ — الشَّقُّ الْعَمِيقُ الَّذِي يُخْرِجُ مَا فِيهِ
shades.explanation: The nafj (piercing) appears in three Quranic contexts. The most famous is 67:30-31 - the divine nafj of the original unity into the multiplicity of creation.
shades.hadith_en: The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful
